fields.record_id: Unique option/recommendation ID, distinct from existing interpretation IDs
fields.state: accepted | rejected | refused | unresolved | insufficient_evidence | not_comparable | unknown
fields.action: Proposed action as advisory public prose
fields.upside: Expected upside with no fabricated certainty
fields.assumptions: Array of explicit assumption strings; empty only when no additional assumptions are asserted
fields.uncertainty: Public statement of uncertainty or limits, not an internal reasoning trace
fields.source_ids: Array of accepted supplied source IDs, including all sources for linked interpretations and trajectories
fields.interpretation_ids: Array of accepted supplied interpretation/position record IDs
fields.trajectory_ids: Array of accepted supplied movement/trajectory record IDs
fields.actor_ids: Array of affected actor IDs covered by the cited source graph
fields.issue_ids: Array of affected issue IDs covered by the cited source graph
fields.round_ids: Array of all round IDs covered by cited sources
fields.option_ids: Empty array for an option; for a recommendation, IDs of supported accepted options from this response

directives: Return canonical {agent, doc_id, items}; doc_id is case_id. Every item is flat, with array fields containing strings only.
Type is STRATEGIC_OPTION or RECOMMENDATION. State and confidence use the existing stable enums. Advice is not observed evidence or a governance decision.
Offer competing defensible options, or one option when alternatives lack support. Return an empty items list when evidence cannot support advice. Do not fabricate strategic certainty.

Each option carries action, upside, risk, assumptions, uncertainty, source_ids, interpretation_ids, trajectory_ids, actor_ids, issue_ids and round_ids. Link only accepted supplied evidence and records; include all evidence of linked records.

Recommendations are permitted only in mode recommendation, must link option_ids and their supporting trajectory, interpretations, evidence and assumptions. Options have empty option_ids. Preserve uncertainty and competing interpretations.
Never derive a strategy automatically from a movement enum or numeric change. Evaluate source support independently; prior author identity is not proof.
Write public prose in the configured run output language. Preserve field names, identifiers, enums, numbers and source quotations.

fields.state: accepted | rejected | refused | unresolved | insufficient_evidence | not_comparable | unknown
fields.source_ids: Copy all source_ids of reviewed proposal

directives: Cross-check each proposal against supplied source evidence and round/actor/issue attribution. Do not draft replacement content. Return one flat review item per target_record_id, or withhold judgment explicitly.
Acceptance does not resolve ambiguity. Preserve UNCERTAIN when evidence admits competing interpretations.
Reject unsupported claims, unsupported continuity, ungrounded advice and self-certifying evidence. Never infer meaning from numeric equality alone.
Review advisory proposals separately from observed evidence. Reject missing source/trajectory/option provenance and unsupported certainty. Do not invent or rewrite advice.
